description: Nested real-connectome selections. Circuit size changes anatomical coverage and compute cost; it is not an intelligence score.

tiers.label: Compact
tiers.description: Path core only. Lightest workload; the most surrounding anatomy is omitted.

tiers.label: Balanced
tiers.description: Path core plus 700 strongly connected neighboring neurons.

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.description: Path core plus 1,800 neighbors. The original calibrated circuit.

tiers.label: Expanded
tiers.description: Path core plus 4,912 neighbors. More anatomy and a heavier workload, not guaranteed better play.
